name: comp-410
title: Avatar Group Muted Pill
blurb: Muted pill-shaped avatar group with overflow indicator.
description: Renders four circular avatars at 40px size inside a muted rounded-pill container with an overflow button showing "+3". Avatars use ring-muted styling to blend with the container background.
use_when: Subtle avatar groups that need to sit on the page without strong visual contrast, like in secondary sections or…
avoid_when: When avatars need to stand out prominently, or when the count of hidden avatars is dynamic.
a11y: Avatar images have alt text. The overflow button is a Button component with keyboard and focus support.
